description: Browse all watches, filter by brand or collection, or look up specific products on Collective Horology.

availableOnly.description: Only emit products that are currently in stock.
availableOnly.title: Available only

brandFilter.description: Case-insensitive substring filter on brand/vendor name, e.g. `ming`, `czapek`, `arcanaut`.
brandFilter.title: Filter by brand (vendor)

collectionHandle.description: Shopify collection slug, e.g. `ming`, `czapek`, `armin-strom`. Used only in browseCollection mode.
collectionHandle.title: Collection handle (mode=browseCollection)

maxPrice.description: Skip products with a price above this value.
maxPrice.title: Max price (USD)

mode.description: What to fetch from Collective Horology.
enumTitles: Look up specific products by handle or URL
mode.title: Mode

productHandles.description: Shopify product handles, e.g. `czapek-promenade-goutte-de-rosee` or a full product URL. Used only in byProductIds mode.
productHandles.title: Product handles or URLs (mode=byProductIds)

title: Collective Horology Scraper Input
